description: After a unit passes gate, hand its commands to its port.rs: adds the unit crate to rust/app as a library, writes a glue stub (src/units/<unit>.rs, yours to write: parse args, call <crate>::port, print what the original prints), regenerates the routing with a kill switch RUST_ANYTHING_UNIT_<NAME>=original, then builds and replays. Run it again after writing the glue: 100% passed and a lower fallback rate.

commands.description: Commands the unit answers; kept from the last wire when omitted.

routes.description: Servers: routes the unit answers, axum syntax: "GET /users/{id}", "/path" for any method, "*" for everything else; kept from the last wire when omitted.

skip_gate.description: Do not run gate on the unit first.

unit.description: Unit crate folder, its name under rust/, or the unit id it was bridged from.

name: app_wire
title: Wire unit into app
